patterns.note: Full-width sections with content constrained to a central maximum width, often featuring asymmetrical arrangements of large text and complex illustrative graphics or device mockups.

Very large, bold, sans-serif headings are used for hero and major section titles, creating strong visual impact, complemented by a readable sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels for secondary information.
Alternating background colors (off-white, dark forest green, light grey, vibrant yellow) are used to visually segment content sections and provide clear visual rhythm.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site navigation as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections and content blocks reveal themselves with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.
A 'hero with complex visual' pattern combines a strong, concise headline and call to action with a detailed graphic featuring device mockups and multiple app icons.

technique_notes: Sticky Navigation: The header navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining access to key links as the user scrolls.

Scroll-triggered Reveals: Sections and content blocks animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, characteristic of `locomotive-scroll` implementations, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.

Alternating Section Backgrounds: The page uses distinct background colors (white, dark green, light grey, vibrant yellow) for different content sections to visually segment the page and provide rhythm.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, often uppercase labels for secondary information.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some card elements, but predominantly sharp corners for overall layout blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its confident use of a vibrant yellow accent color to punctuate an otherwise professional, muted palette, effectively drawing attention to key calls to action and illustrative sections. This is paired with a strong typographic hierarchy and detailed, engaging device mockups and waveform graphics, creating a visual language that feels both authoritative and approachable.
